facts.statement: Silurolepis lived during the Ludlow epoch of the Silurian period.
The species Silurolepis platydorsalis was formally described by Zhang and colleagues in 2010.
facts.quote: it was finally described by Zhang et al., in 2010

facts.statement: A 2019 study reclassified Silurolepis as a maxillate placoderm closely related to Qilinyu.
facts.quote: a 2019 study instead recovers it as a maxillate placoderm most closely related to Qilinyu

facts.statement: Silurolepis platydorsalis is known from thoracic armor featuring a very flat dorsal side.
facts.quote: S. platydorsalis is known from thoracic armor: as the specific name suggests, the dorsal side is very flat

facts.statement: Silurolepis belongs to the class Placodermi.
Silurolepis lived between 426.7 and 425 million years ago during the Gorstian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Gorstian to Gorstian (426.7 to 425 million years ago)
